title: Snake
lastAssistantText:
The repair is complete. Summary:

## Diagnosis
The game scheduled a new `requestAnimationFrame` chain on every pause/resume and restart without cancelling the previous one, so rapid pause/resume before the next frame let animation chains accumulate (1 → 6 …).

**Root cause:** `togglePause()` on pause never called `cancelAnimationFrame(rafId)`, leaving the pending frame running; combined with `loop()`'s resume, both loops ran. Separately, `loop()` is the sole owner of `rafId` (it assigns `rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop)` on its last line), so callers must invoke `loop(lastTime)` as a statement — assigning its return (`undefined`, since an assignment-statement returns nothing) would wipe the id `loop` just set.

## Fix (index.html only, surgical)
- `togglePause()` pause branch: added `cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);`
- `start()` and resume keep the plain `loop(lastTime);` (registers exactly one frame, stores its id)

No game logic touched — growth, score/speed, wall/self collision, departing-tail, food, and win are preserved.

## Verification (through real handlers + scheduled callbacks)
Wrapped `requestAnimationFrame`/`cancelAnimationFrame` via the native-runtime harness and drove the game through its keyboard handlers. All 8 core chain checks PASS: start=1 chain, 5× rapid pause/resume=1 chain (was 6), after advance=1, 3 restarts=1, pause=0 (no accumulation while paused), resume=1. Wall collision and food eating (score reached 3) confirmed preserved.

## Deliverables
- `index.html` — fixed, still a single self-contained offline file
- `VERIFY.md` — exact checks, root cause, and remaining limitations

The only noted limitation is a pre-existing cosmetic one: the button label isn't refreshed on restart/resume (behavior is correct, only the label text can be stale) — left as-is since it's out of scope.
